thread:
leah: Quick brief  preparing Jun 8 webinar + benchmark hub. Need: a modular benchmark card system (compact / stacked / ribbon variants), a single-panel routing diagram that explains Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private fallback, and Figma components with export-ready slices. Also need brand sign-off before we lock assets.

diego: I can run the cards. Do we want animated micro-interactions for the webinar overlay or keep everything static?

leah: Keep the cards static for the site + one looping GIF (700ms) for the webinar opener. Please include accessible color tokens and a clear methodology tooltip.

ravi: I'll take the routing diagram and create a simplified flow showing request routing + fallback rules. Use plain icons, no gradients. Link to illustration tokens: https://figma.com/file/brand-illustration-tokens 

ops-sam: One ops ask  include a data hook on each exported asset: data-campaign="bench-jun2026" and an export layer containing utm_source=webinar and utm_campaign=bench_jun. We want to A/B route leads based on which card they click.

diego: Agreed. Suggested card fields: short model name, cost/1k tokens, median p50 latency @N, quantization recommendation, tiny quality one-liner (sourced). Add a small pill for deployment availability (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).

leah: Sizes: compact 360x200, wide 720x200, hero 1280x640. Deliverables: Figma components + SVGs + PNG @1x & @2x + single GIF 800x450. Make a locale layer (en/de/fr). Keep copy short.

ravi: Brand constraints: Redwood Sans for headings, Inter for body. Icon strokes 1.5-2px, do not flatten type. Contrast min 4.5:1 for text. Charts must be linear scale and include units. No use of "best" without a clear benchmark citation.

diego: Adding a hidden Figma component layer called "dev-attrs" with text nodes for data-campaign and utm string. Naming convention for exports: rw_bench_{variant}_{size}_{locale}.png e.g. rw_bench_compact_360x200_en.png

design-bot: Figma upload: https://figma.com/file/xyz789/modular-bench-cards-v0 (components + variant sets + export presets).

leah: Export spec (put in Figma notes) 
```
Export presets:
- Cards: SVG (icons/paths), PNG @1x, PNG @2x
- Hero: SVG + PNG @2x (1280px wide)
- GIF: 800x450, ~60fps, 700	600ms loop
File names: rw_bench_{variant}_{size}_{locale}.{png|svg}
Dev attrs: layer "dev-attrs" -> data-campaign / utm_source / utm_campaign
```

ops-sam: Timeline: first pass by Mon (2167040000), feedback Tue, final exports Thu. I'll provision campaign stubs once assets are in.

diego: On it. I'll post the Figma link and drop initial PNG sprites when ready.

leah: Great. Keep comments in Figma for copy iterations. I'll route brand review to @ravi for color/token sign-off. Thanks all :sparkles:
